name: update_assessment
description: Patch the incident with new victim details as the caller shares them. Re-runs triage on the backend. Only include fields you actually learned this turn — do NOT re-send unchanged data.

request_body_schema.description: Patch fields into the primary victim record on an existing incident.

victim.description: Victim fields to patch. Include only what you learned this turn.

ageEstimate.description: Estimated age in years (0-120). Only if the caller stated it.

injuries.description: Short phrases naming visible injuries, e.g. 'leg laceration', 'burns'.

consciousness.description: Level of responsiveness. Use 'unknown' if the caller can't tell.

breathing.description: Breathing status. 'spontaneous' = breathing normally; 'absent' = not breathing after airway opened.

perfusion.description: Capillary refill / pulse status. 'normal' = refill <2s OR radial pulse present.

mobility.description: Mobility. 'walking' = can walk; 'cannot_follow_commands' = trapped or unresponsive.

vulnerabilities.description: Vulnerability flags, e.g. mobility_dependent, oxygen, child, elderly.

confidence.description: Your confidence (0-1) in the patched assessment.
